label: PanTHERIA: a species-level database of life history, ecology, and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals (MSW05 version, August 2008)
bibliographic_citation: Jones KE, Bielby J, Cardillo M, Fritz SA, O'Dell J, Orme CDL, Safi K, Sechrest W, Boakes EH, Carbone C, Connolly C, Cutts MJ, Foster JK, Grenyer R, Habib M, Plaster CA, Price SA, Rigby EA, Rist J, Teacher A, Bininda-Emonds ORP, Gittleman JL, Mace GM, Purvis A (2009) PanTHERIA: a species-level database of life history, ecology, and geography of extant and recently extinct mammals. Ecology 90:2648.
license: Ecological Archives data paper; free for non-commercial use with citation
measurement_technique: Literature-compiled species-level traits for mammals (body mass, metabolic rate, litter size, gestation, longevity, diet breadth, home range, population density, geographic range) following Wilson & Reeder 2005 taxonomy.
role: body mass, life-history and ecological traits for the listed mammal taxa (rows matched on MSW05_Binomial / MSW05_Genus / MSW05_Family)

counts.description: rows matching the listed taxa: canidae=35, homo-sapiens=1, elephantidae=3, bos-taurus=1, equus-caballus=1, lepus=32, rhinocerotidae=5, panthera-tigris=1, canis-lupus-familiaris=1, apodemus=20, mus=38, felis-catus=1, ovis-aries=1, rattus=66, cervidae=51, panthera-leo=1, sus-scrofa=1, canis-lupus=1, oryctolagus-cuniculus=1, ornithorhynchus-anatinus=1
